insight: Born from Google's May 2025 acquisition of Galileo AI, whose standalone UI generator was folded into Google Labs as Stitch.
name: Stitch
tagline: Turn prompts and sketches into UI designs and frontend code.
description: An AI design tool from Google Labs that generates app and website interfaces from natural-language prompts, images, wireframes, or sketches. It produces multiple design variants, exports clean layouts to Figma, and outputs frontend code (HTML/CSS, Tailwind), with a voice-driven Live Mode for real-time adjustments. Powered by Gemini's multimodal capabilities and free with generous limits while in beta.
edge: Free prompt-to-UI generation with both Figma export and frontend code output — peers typically gate one or the other behind paid plans.
pros: Exports to both Figma and code

references.title: Google Stitch Review: I Spoke an App Into Existence with AI
